title: The workers view accepted identifiers, hostnames, problems, and instants outside the OpenAPI scalars: whitespace and 129 characters in workerId, control characters and 1,025 characters in texts, and date-only instants
resolution: isIdentifier, isDisplayText, and isUtcInstant check the document's Identifier, DisplayText, and Instant patterns and lengths; boundary tests of the wire and adapter assertions that such bodies read as unavailable; the board's checks are unchanged.

title: A failed check's details array was kept by reference, so a property planted on the body's array or a later change to it reached the view
resolution: The validated problems are copied into a new array; the test checks reference independence, a change after the read, and a planted array property.

title: A self-check's text was a paragraph holding the list of its problems, invalid HTML that React warned about on the console
resolution: The self-check text renders as Text component="div"; every page test, the redaction test included, fails on any unexpected console output.

title: The record claimed 100% on every metric for WorkersServices.tsx and BoardServices.tsx, whose missing-provider guards the cited log showed at 50% branches
resolution: services-providers.test.tsx covers both guards; the record cites the first log's real numbers and the rerun at 100% branches, and separates the aggregate thresholds from the per-file figures.

title: The overtaken-read test settled the stale answer through a zero-delay setTimeout rather than a barrier
resolution: The stale answer is resolved inside an asynchronous act, which flushes the resulting updates before the assertions.

title: The redaction comment of the page test ran three lines, which the checker missed because it skips .tsx files
resolution: The comment is two lines; the checker's omission of .tsx files is a follow-up for the coordinator, not changed here.

title: The design said the session's roles are read once at sign-in and hold until the next sign-in, although SessionProvider rereads the session at its expiry and on refresh
resolution: The design and record describe the roles as a snapshot of the last successful session read; page tests cover a grant and a revoke through the expiry check, with request counts and the dropped outstanding read.

title: The single-column Stack replaced the POC's responsive SimpleGrid without a requirement or decision, against the claim that every departure has one
resolution: The cards sit in the POC's SimpleGrid (cols base 1, sm 2, xl 4), pinned by a page test; the design's departure list no longer claims an authority for each item.

title: The record linked its design relatively ([design](design.md)) rather than root-relative
resolution: Protocol step 6 allows a record to link inside its change directory and forbids a link to an active change, and verify:links refuses the root-relative form; the review prompt's root-relative-only criterion is a follow-up for the coordinator.
